## Page attribution

The T04 extractor attributed pages by counting Word's cached `<w:lastRenderedPageBreak>`. On T04 that happened to land on the frozen range. On all four of these units it does not — it under-counts the last page of T03-B03, T03-B04 and T05-B01 by one and over-counts T06-B01 by one. Trusting it would have published a wrong page range for every unit in this batch while the frozen map was right all along.

Page attribution now comes from the rendered PDF, which is hash-verified and prints its own module page number in the footer. The cached-layout number is still computed and still reported, as the weaker second opinion it always was.
